effect_applied.description: null when it is unknown whether the effect took place
effect_applied.title: Effect Applied

based_on_revision.description: observation state_revision the proposal relied on
based_on_revision.title: Based On Revision

observation_request.description: ask for fresh observations first; `action` is the fallback if none are possible

ArtifactRef.description: Pointer to a large object held by an ArtifactStore (never inlined into events).

uri.description: object location, e.g. file://… or s3://bucket/key
uri.title: Uri

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

value.description: value the plan assumed (null for free UNKNOWN locations)
value.title: Value

AssumptionSet.description: Everything a belief-based conclusion assumed beyond fresh observations (P2-025).
AssumptionSet.title: AssumptionSet

extensions.description: namespaced extension slots; keys are reverse-DNS namespaces, formal-lab.core.* is reserved
extensions.title: Extensions

observation_request.description: UNKNOWN precondition: which observations would settle it (v2)

scope.description: conclusion holds for the model, not for the real system
scope.title: Scope

max_steps.description: maximum path length explored (0 for single-step queries)
max_steps.title: Max Steps

ConditionCheck.description: One business / resource condition evaluated by an execution gate.

holds.description: None: the gate could not determine it
holds.title: Holds

ConditionCheck.title: ConditionCheck

ConflictInfo.description: Why a proposal based on an older world revision was rejected (shared-resource arbitration).
ConflictInfo.title: ConflictInfo

domain.description: enum or entity set of a symbolic value; required when ambiguous
domain.title: Domain

CostTerm.description:
One additive cost term of an objective level.

- action_cost: `weight` × the declared `cost` of every action taken on the path.
- state_rate: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on every post-state s_1..s_k of the path.
- terminal: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on the final state s_k of the path.
CostTerm.title: CostTerm

expected_by.description: what produced the expectation, e.g. model:<package>@<version>
expected_by.title: Expected By

EvidenceRef.description: Reference to something that supports a claim: an event, artifact, check or snapshot.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

ExecutionDecision.description:
Typed record of one pre-execution decision (phase 3A, G2): kept on the operation record and as an event, so
decision, operation record and the backend's side effect can be traced to each other.
ExecutionDecision.title: ExecutionDecision

ExecutionPhase.description: Which kind of send a pre-execution decision is about (phase 3A, G2).
ExecutionPhase.title: ExecutionPhase

Extension.description: Namespaced, versioned extension payload. `schema_id` names the JSON Schema that validates `data`.
Extension.title: Extension

evidence.description: basis of `observed`: fresh observation, verified within a stated scope (probe / operation query), or unknown (not comparable); `predicted` marks a value only the model supplies (v2)
evidence.title: Evidence

ModelUsage.description: Model usage of one proposal: `model_calls` usable responses, `attempts` requests sent; tokens as reported.
ModelUsage.title: ModelUsage

proven_lower.description: no plan within the horizon is cheaper than this
proven_lower.title: Proven Lower

proven_upper.description: a plan at most this expensive exists
proven_upper.title: Proven Upper

value.description: objective value of the returned plan
value.title: Value

ObjectiveLevel.description: One lexicographic level: minimise (or maximise) the sum of its terms over the path.
ObjectiveLevel.title: ObjectiveLevel

ObjectiveSpec.description:
What a cost-aware planner optimises (P2-020).

A candidate plan is a path s_0 → … → s_k (k ≤ horizon) that ends in the first state where `goal_property`
holds. Its value on each level is the sum of the level's terms over that path (see `CostTerm`); levels are
compared lexicographically in list order. Costs stop accumulating once the goal holds.
ObjectiveSpec.title: ObjectiveSpec

requested_paths.description: locations observed fresh on request (OBSERVE_MORE, v2)
requested_paths.title: Requested Paths

semantics.default: Facts are what the actor observed (possibly stale, see observed_at_step); unknowns are locations whose current value the actor cannot know at this step. The environment truth state is a separate object that agents never receive.
semantics.title: Semantics

step.description: logical step at which the observation is taken
step.title: Step

turn.description: turn the observation was taken for (v2)

ObservationRequest.description: Extra observations that would settle an UNKNOWN verdict (P2-027).

for_action.description: ground action key the request is about
for_action.title: For Action

ObservationRequest.title: ObservationRequest

OperationEffect.description: What one operation transition did to the backend (phase 3A, G2): reading history is not a side effect.
OperationEffect.title: OperationEffect

OperationRecord.description:
Coordination record of one environment operation (P2-051). Intent is recorded before dispatch; every state
change is kept with its reason.

batch_id.description: JOINT_BATCH: the batch this operation submitted
batch_id.title: Batch Id

batch_outcomes.description: JOINT_BATCH: one outcome per submitted proposal, in submission order
batch_outcomes.title: Batch Outcomes

request_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical request (actor, kind, action); the same id with another request is a conflict (phase 3A)
request_digest.title: Request Digest

OperationRecord.title: OperationRecord

effect.description: what this transition did to the backend (phase 3A); absent in records written before it

method.default: incremental bound tightening (binary search per lexicographic level)
method.title: Method

ProbeResult.description: An independent business observation (P2-064): taken from the service itself, not from the agent's view.

source.description: where the value was read, e.g. GET /metrics of the order service
source.title: Source

ProbeResult.title: ProbeResult

model.description: model identifier for LLM / LLM_STUB sources
model.title: Model

QuantExpr.description:
forall/exists → bool, count → number of satisfying members, sum → sum of an int body,
max_over/min_over → largest/smallest int body over the satisfying members (`default` when there is none).

default.description: max_over/min_over only: value when no member qualifies
default.title: Default

domain.description: entity set or enum to range over
domain.title: Domain

QuantExpr.title: QuantExpr

found.description: the environment knows the operation (it took effect or was rejected)
found.title: Found

RefExpr.description: Reads an action parameter or a quantifier-bound variable.
RefExpr.title: RefExpr

RobustnessResult.description:
Open-loop robustness of a fixed action sequence over all completions (P2-026). This is not policy
synthesis: the sequence cannot branch on later observations.

counterexample.description: completion of the unknowns that breaks it
counterexample.title: Counterexample

RobustnessResult.title: RobustnessResult

solver_status.description: raw backend status, e.g. sat / unsat / unknown / not-run
solver_status.title: Solver Status

StageRecord.description: Typed record of one execution stage (P2-016): inputs/outputs by digest, retry semantics, error, evidence.
StageRecord.title: StageRecord

TurnRef.description: Position of one action in the interleaving: global step g, round r, and the actor's own step count.

env_step.description: JOINT_BATCH: environment step the batch was applied at (one per batch, phase 3A)
env_step.title: Env Step

TurnRef.title: TurnRef

extension_point.description: interface through which support can be added
extension_point.title: Extension Point

VarExpr.description: Reads a state variable or a constant table at the given index.
VarExpr.title: VarExpr

action.description: action leading into this state (null for step 0)
